public_problem.body:
The DWSIM air-liquefaction flowsheet runs headlessly, but the selected product stream misses its purity target.

Adjust only the feed stage for column `{target_tag}` / GUID `{target_guid}`. Propose a structured repair action so that `{target_component}` mole fraction in material stream `{target_stream_tag}` is at least `{target_min}` after rerunning the flowsheet.

Expected repair action type: `set_unit_parameter`.
